svg.title: A field of 600
svg.desc: A long, thin rectangle drawn ten times as long as it is wide. The short side is labeled width, about 7.75. The long side is labeled length, about 77.5. The area, 600, is written inside.

text.font-family: 'Liberation Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', Palatino, Georgia, serif
'Liberation Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: Ten times as long as it is wide. Drawn to scale.

svg.text: Width times length is 600. The shape is long and thin because one side is ten times the other.
